notes: A linguistic resource for the normaliser, not benchmark text. Number words come from src/afandem/lints/lexicons/numbers.json (one list for lints and scoring); this file holds the currency markers only.
currency: markers removed before the amount is read. The orthographic variant «جنية» reaches «جنيه» through folding (ة→ه) and needs no entry of its own; it is listed so the table is complete.
half: «جنيه ونص» adds 0.5 («١٢ جنيه ونص» = 12.5); integer EGP is the expected form, so a half is reported as a fraction.
